hits.text:
Rich people come in 3 types, know which one you’re selling to:

1. Negotiates everything
2. Doesn’t care about price, just wants the problem gone

Shoppers at a craft fair come in 3 types:

1. Asks the price, walks the room, comes back an hour later
2. Picks it up and buys it, no questions
3. Loves it, takes a card, and you never find out

Which one do you set your table up for?
